question: Should OpenClaw adopt `api.registerReadinessCriterion` as a supported public Plugin SDK contract before hosting profiles depend on it?
rationale: This choice determines the long-term external API and compatibility commitment; it cannot be resolved safely from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Approve the readiness Plugin SDK contract
options.body: Treat plugin-owned bounded readiness observations and their selection identifiers as supported API, then continue review of the dependent readiness and profile stack.

options.title: Defer plugin registration from V1
options.body: Keep hosting-profile work scoped to core-owned conditions until maintainers choose a stable plugin readiness API.

recommendation.title: Approve the readiness Plugin SDK contract
recommendation.body: Treat plugin-owned bounded readiness observations and their selection identifiers as supported API, then continue review of the dependent readiness and profile stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active linked readiness proposal stack and can clarify or reshape the implementation after the maintainer direction is chosen.
